h1: Get update messages for selected models
description: A WebSocket subscription for changes to models selected by model key. Messages describe models being created, updated or removed and may include multiple model IDs. Event messages describe creations and updates only; event removals are not sent.

queryParameters.name: modelKeys
queryParameters.description: Model keys to subscribe to, comma-separated or supplied as repeated query parameters: nvr, camera, chime, light, viewer, speaker, bridge, sensor, siren, fob, relay, aiProcessor, aiPort, linkStation, event, externalArmProfile.

children.name: id
children.description: The primary key of nvr

children.name: modelKey
children.description: The model key of the nvr

children.name: type
children.description: The NVR model name.

children.name: guid
children.description: GUID of the NVR

children.name: mac
children.description: The primary MAC address of the device.

children.name: featureFlags
children.description: Feature flags.

children.name: useExternalAlarmManager
children.description: Whether UniFi OS runs the external Alarm Manager instead of Protect. When false, Protect runs the local Alarm Manager; when true, UniFi OS runs the external Alarm Manager.

children.name: defaultMessageText
children.description: Default text to display on the LCD screen.

children.name: defaultMessageResetTimeoutMs
children.description: Default timeout for resetting LCD screen to the default message.

children.name: customMessages
children.description: A list of custom doorbell messages.

children.name: customImages
children.description: A list of custom doorbell images for client preview.

children.name: armMode
children.description: Local Alarm Manager profile arm state. Use this when `nvr.featureFlags.useExternalAlarmManager` is false. When it is true, retrieve External Alarm Manager profile state from `GET /integration/v1/external/arm-profiles`.

local.python:
import asyncio
import websockets

async def main():
    url = "wss://192.168.0.1/proxy/protect/integration/v1/subscribe/updates?modelKeys=%7BmodelKeys%7D"
    headers = {
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "X-API-Key": "<X-API-Key>",
    }
    async with websockets.connect(url, additional_headers=headers) as ws:
        async for message in ws:
            print(message)

asyncio.run(main())
